title: Marion County’s November Election Calendar: Five Dates to Check at the Source
thumbnailMessage: November election. Five dates to check.
summary: The county lists registration, early-voting, mail-application and Election Day dates. Keep the current official notice beside any shared calendar.
content:
Marion County’s November election page publishes a calendar residents can check directly. RepWatchr reviewed the page on September 29. These are county-published dates, not dates inferred from a campaign post.

## The posted calendar

October 5: last day to register. October 19: early voting begins. October 23: mail-ballot applications must be received, not merely postmarked. October 30: early voting ends. November 3: Election Day; the county lists voting from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

## Read the notice beside the calendar

A date card is a starting point. Confirm current hours, locations, precinct information, and any updates on the county page. Check eligibility questions with the elections office rather than treating a social comment as an official answer.

The same page links precinct-specific sample ballots. Choose the relevant sample instead of circulating a cropped contest without its precinct and election date.

## Keep corrections traceable

When a notice changes, retain the earlier date of your review and label the correction. Send the new official link to the source desk. Sharing the source with the date lets another reader verify the information without relying on the person who reposted it.

This guide does not establish candidate qualification or report results. AI-assisted draft; publication remains subject to human editorial review.
